Hi Alex / Jared —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and MAP-focused asks so we have clear owners and target dates: 

Call highlights (short):
- Use case: Secure PHI inference for provider workflow; expected 5M tokens/mo baseline, spikes up to 20M.
- Key blocker: MSA/DPA redlines and SLA language around data retention and audit logs.
- Compliance asks: SOC 2 + KMS integration + event-level audit logs.

Attached: StellarHealth_REDLINE_v1.docx (our initial MSA edits) and MAP_Milestones_Stellar_v1.xlsx (milestones, owners, dates).

Proposed MAP milestone: Legal sign-off on MSA/DPA/SLA language
- Target close date: 2027-06-30 (internal target; flexible by 1 week if SOC evidence needs time)
- Dependencies: SOC2 report availability, procurement PO, KMS access confirmation

Who we propose owns what (please confirm or propose edits):
- Redwood: MSA (commercial terms + liability cap language) — owner: Redwood Legal (Vanessa) — first-pass turnaround: 48 business hours after you provide countered redlines
- Stellar Health: DPA / SLA operational redlines (data retention windows, incident MTTR expectations) — owner: Stellar GC (Alex) — first-pass turnaround: 72 business hours
- Joint: Final SLA appendix (both legal and engineering review) — coordinate via this thread; engineering questions loop in Jared

Asks / next steps:
1) Alex: please confirm you accept the owner split above and whether Stellar will circulate DPA markups or prefer Redwood to incorporate suggested DPA language into the MSA redline doc.
2) Vanessa: if you agree with the 48h/72h TATs, please confirm and note any exceptions (e.g., unusual legal terms requiring product/exec input).
3) Marissa: can you add the agreed milestone + owners to the HubSpot MAP and set a reminder for 2027-06-24?

I'll hold a 30-minute sync next Wed (2027-06-09) at 11:00 PT for any contested points — please let me know if that works.

Thanks,

Ben / Alex —

Thanks Ben — I reviewed the attachments quickly. Confirming Redwood Legal will take lead on MSA commercial redlines and will own consolidating edits into a single redline doc to keep versions clear.

Turnaround expectations from Redwood Legal: 
- Initial consolidation and response (first pass) to customer redlines: 48 business hours from receipt of customer's counter-redline document.
- If proposed changes are limited to standard commercial terms (cap, indemnity, warranty), we will stay within the 48h window.
- If changes introduce non-standard security obligations (e.g., expanded breach notification windows, live access to logs), allow additional 3 business days for legal+engineering review.

Regarding DPA / SLA: we prefer Stellar to mark the DPA/SLA and send to us. Redwood will review SLA appendix and propose operational clarifications as needed. For efficiency, we can draft a suggested SLA appendix if Stellar prefers — ping me and we can start that in parallel.

I accept being the Redwood owner here (Vanessa O.). I will ask my legal ops partner to treat this as a priority queue item once Stellar provides their input.

Ben — please add the milestone to HubSpot and set the 6/24 reminder as suggested.

V.O.
Vanessa Ortiz
